payload.core_mechanism_summary: Split array into even and odd indices, converting constraint a_i≠a_{i+2} to no adjacent equals in each subsequence. Precompute DP arrays for number of ways to fill gaps between fixed elements with no adjacent equals, using recurrences for equal/different endpoints.
payload.rationale: Solution uses dynamic programming to count assignments for two independent sequences. The DP recurrence on gap length matches the dp_counting_combinatorics subtype, as it counts combinations under adjacency constraints. No other subtype (tree, interval, etc.) applies.
